title: Quietly Pungent Polish Meat Dumplings
description: Silky Polish dumplings filled with a pungent mix of meats and rose water, wrapped in lotus leaves for a nostalgic and low-sodium meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, ground beef, rose water, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Season the mixture with low-sodium salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Lay a lotus leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 cup of the meat mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat the process with the remaining lotus leaves and meat mixture.
Place the dumplings in a steamer basket, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
